CustomField.description: ONE-WAY LATCH. Set true when the breach alert has been sent, and never cleared. FSD 5.9.7 requires that an alert never re-fires, and without a latch the nightly job would re-notify on every subsequent run for as long as the commitment stays breached.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked once the breach alert has gone out. Never unticked - clearing it would re-send the alert.
CustomField.label: Breach Notified
